subject: Quantify pilot: scope, success checkpoints, and role handoffs
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@quantifyanalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quantify pilot: scope, success checkpoints, and role handoffs

Elena — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum going.

Summary of what we heard (your confirmation appreciated):
- Goal: validate latency and cost profile for search re-ranking on a 50M document index (sampling).
- Success criteria (customer-visible): mean 95th latency < 350ms for single-query re-rank, embedding similarity recall >= 92% on our benchmark set, and system cost < $0.015 per 1k queries in steady state.
- Duration: 3-week pilot: week 0 (setup), week 1 (load & baseline), week 2 (tuning + eval), week 3 (report & recommendations).

Immediate asks from your side:
- Confirmation of internal owners for infra, app, and security (name + best contact email).
- A small sample of the index (or an obfuscated subset) and expected query distribution by Wednesday 03/10.
- PO/Procurement contact so we can surface enterprise terms during pilot scope if needed.

Internal asks / proposed owners (please confirm or reassign):
- Infrastructure & access: Karthik Iyer — provision test GPU VPC and a timeboxed SSH window for onboarding.
- Application integration champion: Neha Kapoor — will own adapter integration and runtime validation.
- Security & compliance lead: Priyom Das — handle questionnaire and any network/KMS items.
- Commercial/procurement follow-up: Marissa Cole — will handle billing and draft SOW language.

I've attached: Redwood-Quantify-POC-Checklist.xlsx (pilot checklist), Security-Questionnaire-Quantify.pdf.

Planned checkpoint cadence: 30-min kickoff + weekly 30-min progress reviews (Tuesdays) + final wrap-up. Proposed kickoff: Mon 03/08 10:00 PT — can your team make that?

Thanks — I'll loop in calendar invites once owners are confirmed.

— Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Field GTM, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com

Attachment: Redwood-Quantify-POC-Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet with tasks; see tabs: setup, infra, eval, acceptance)
Attachment: Security-Questionnaire-Quantify.pdf (completed 70% — Priyom to finish)

From: Elena Morales <elena@quantifyanalytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Baker <tbaker@quantifyanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 4 Mar 2027 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quantify pilot: scope, success checkpoints, and role handoffs

Vivek — thanks for the thorough recap, that aligns with what we discussed. Quick notes from our side: we confirm the goal and the high-level success criteria. A couple of clarifications: 

- The 50M index will be provided as an obfuscated subset (we'll deliver ~2.5M docs first to avoid leakage).
- We can hit the proposed kickoff on Mon 03/08 10:00 PT.

Internal owners on our end:
- Platform/infra: Tom Baker (tbaker@quantifyanalytics.com) — he'll coordinate access windows and cloud accounts.
- Product/app owner: Elena Morales (me) — handling adapter and acceptance; will provide test queries.
- Procurement: Sarah Low (sarah.low@quantifyanalytics.com) — she'll handle the PO; CC will follow with contract timelines.

Tom will upload the sample index to the Drive link you shared by COB Friday (03/05). We'll also attach a short procurement note (sent separately) about PO timing for the pilot ($18k estimate).

Thanks — Elena

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@quantifyanalytics.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quantify pilot: scope, success checkpoints, and role handoffs

Thanks — confirming internal RACI and next operational steps from our side. I'll own procurement comms and the SOW draft until legal signs off. Below is the working RACI for the pilot (R=Responsible, A=Accountable, C=Consulted, I=Informed):

- Infrastructure & access
  - R: Karthik Iyer (karthik_iyer@redwood.com) — set up test VPC, firewall rules, and scheduled SSH windows.
  - A: Vivek Kulkarni — final signoff on infra readiness.
  - C: Priyom Das — confirm KMS and logs collection approach.

- Adapter / App integration
  - R: Neha Kapoor — implement and validate adapter, run integration smoke tests.
  - A: Neha Kapoor — acceptance of integration milestones.
  - C: Karthik Iyer — ensure network paths and permission scope are appropriate.

- Security & Compliance
  - R: Priyom Das — complete remaining items in Security-Questionnaire-Quantify.pdf and run a quick threat model for the pilot.
  - A: Priyom Das — liaise with Quantify security as needed.
  - I: Marissa Cole — procurement implications if any controls require additional tooling.

- Commercial / Procurement
  - R: Marissa Cole — draft SOW + provisional invoice details.
  - A: Marissa Cole — coordinate with Sarah Low once procurement reaches out.

Operational timeline (short):
- Fri 03/05: Quantify uploads sample to Drive (Elena/Tom) — Karthik to confirm receipt.
- Mon 03/08 10:00 PT: Kickoff (30m) — agenda: access, acceptance criteria, baseline plan.
- Tue 03/09: baseline run start (Karthik/Neha) — target 24–48h for baseline metrics.
- Wed 03/17: tuning complete, internal review.
- Fri 03/19: final report + recommendations.

Two small asks:
1) Karthik — please create the VPC and share an access doc by Monday morning.
2) Priyom — I'll assign the outstanding questionnaire items to you in Drive; can you aim to close them by 03/10?

I'll open a HubSpot task and a shared Drive folder (link below) and create the SOW stub. Vivek — if you approve the RACI/timeline I'll send the invites.

HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/67890
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-quantify-poc

— Marissa
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
